development_selection.reason: smallest tested descriptive tier with positive 10-km mean lift over same-size random in both mixed and plant development cohorts after intention-to-evaluate empty-tier correction

robust_patch_rule.prototype_rule: training occurrences only; deterministic spatial thinning to at most 32 complete unique environmental prototypes
robust_patch_rule.support_rule: leave-one-prototype-out median percentile rank with float32 support worlds
robust_patch_rule.empty_tier_rule: retain declared fold with selected_cells=0, recall=0, random_mean_recall=0, lift=0

candidate_universe.rule: one deterministic land-point surface per predeclared taxon-region cell, shared across all folds in that region

outer_validation.declared_fold_failure_rule: retain in intention-to-evaluate denominator as zero; no taxon replacement after cohort freeze

random_comparator.rule: same candidate universe and same selected-cell count as robust tier within each fold
random_comparator.empty_selected_rule: zero selected cells implies zero random recall

cohort.sampling_rule: for every fixed Japanese region cell x plant/animal x within-frame record-count quartile, sample exactly one previously unused species; no substitution across cells/strata and no replacement after declaration

primary_inference.estimand: mean over five spatial folds of robust 2.5%-tier 10-km recall minus same-size random mean recall
primary_inference.success_gate: overall mean lift >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND sign-flip p < 0.05
primary_inference.cross_taxon_guardrail: plant mean lift > 0 and animal mean lift > 0; subgroup CIs are descriptive unless separately predeclared
primary_inference.failure_interpretation: do not retune support fraction, terrain features, surface size, prototype cap, patch merge distance, or recovery radius after confirmation outcomes

claim_boundary.if_passes: supports cross-taxon enrichment of held-out occurrences by the frozen narrow robust-support candidate tier at the 10-km regional screening scale
does_not_claim: universal optimality of 2.5% outside this ACSP candidate-generation contract
